mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 0.5%) indicates accommodative monetary policy that reduces discount rates for equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS remains below 0.5% for 3 consecutive months but S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of such periods.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in unemployment rate (UNRATE > 8.5%) signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE exceeds 8.5% for 3 consecutive months but S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of such periods.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in housing starts (HOUST > 700,000 units) and retail sales (RSAFS > 400,000 million dollars) indicates robust consumer demand that boosts corporate revenues, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: HOUST and RSAFS both exceed thresholds for 3 consecutive months but S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of such instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO < 97.0 index) signals manufacturing contraction that reduces corporate output and profits, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO falls below 97.0 for 3 consecutive months but S&P 500 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of such periods.

mechanism_narrative: A rising trend in housing starts (HOUST > 700,000 units) signals strong residential construction activity that correlates with higher consumer confidence, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: HOUST exceeds 700,000 units for 3 consecutive months but S&P 500 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of such periods.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in core CPI (CPIAUCSL > 2.5%) signals accelerating inflation that prompts monetary tightening, reducing equity valuations and causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL exceeds 2.5% for 3 consecutive months but S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of such periods.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in unemployment rate (UNRATE < 5.0%) and increase in employment (PAYEMS > 135,000 thousand) indicates labor market strength that supports consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE falls below 5.0% and PAYEMS rises above 135,000 thousand for 3 consecutive months but S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of such instances.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansion (UNRATE < 5.0%), a decline in industrial production (INDPRO < 97.0 index) signals manufacturing contraction that reduces corporate margins, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: When UNRATE < 5.0%, INDPRO < 97.0 for 3 consecutive months but S&P 500 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of such periods.
